absence-evidence-calibration.description: An absence whose search resolves to exactly its accounted matches is accepted.

absence-evidence-contradicted.description: Evidence claims the target does not do something the resolved search finds it doing.

ambiguous-routing.description: Two skills claim the same positive request without explicit primary ownership.

body-path-calibration.description: Strings shaped like paths are not paths: backslashed class names, dotted config keys, constants, placeholders and globs, foreign-layout and installed-tree paths, Twig logical names, files the body commands into existence, and directories the cited configuration itself declares.

body-path-existence.description: A skill body sends the agent to a target file that does not exist.

catalog-role-coverage.description: A selected candidate declares the universal load/execute/verify trio where its catalog obligations belong.

claim-common-lexicon-only.description: A claim clears the language tier but nothing project-specific in it appears in the cited range; support rests entirely on software-English boilerplate ('service', 'method', 'result', 'value').

claim-compound-identifier-calibration.description: Honest prose stays clean when the code spells its subject as one identifier: a claim about the 'reminder' the file only ever writes as publishReminder is accepted.

claim-invariant-lost.description: A high-priority invariant discovery confirmed does not survive into the plan.

claim-language-lexicon-only.description: An invented claim overlaps the cited source only through PHP keywords ('class', 'function', 'public', 'string'), which occur in most PHP files and therefore ground nothing.

claim-php-separator-calibration.description: PHP member separators join compounds like '.' and '/': a true claim naming FrameworkBundle is accepted against the line registering FrameworkBundle::class.

claim-short-config-calibration.description: An eight-line config holds a single sentence of vocabulary, so an honest claim that reuses one of its words and paraphrases the rest is accepted.

claim-single-word-source-calibration.description: A cited file whose whole content is '8.2' can offer one word, so the overlap bar cannot demand two; .php-version stays gradeable and a claim reusing nothing it says is still rejected.

claim-traceability.description: Evidence claims trace through scope, procedure, verification, and output.

contract-rendering.description: An approved procedure step is planned but never reaches the authored skill.

contract-rendering-obligation.description: A catalog obligation is planned but never reaches the authored procedure.

critical-invariant-coverage.description: Every critical invariant reaches a selected skill procedure and verification assertion.

deterministic-output.description: Repeated runs emit byte-identical sorted JSON diagnostics.

duplicate-shared-template.description: Unrelated skills reuse the same generic five-step procedure.

evidence-anchor.description: Skill evidence carries a bounded canonical source anchor.

evidence-anchor-resolution.description: A well-formed anchor must resolve inside the file it cites: a line range past EOF, an inverted range, or an absent symbol cites nothing.

evidence-row-agreement.description: A rendered evidence row keeps a real identifier but re-points it at a path the plan never declared.

evidence-undisposed.description: Evidence sits inside the skill's own declared paths and is neither cited nor ruled out.

exclusive-ownership-write.description: A skill writes a path another skill owns exclusively, including a read-only owner whose own writes are empty.

flow-contract-shape.description: Declared flows use typed stages and resolve every selected skill.

generic-verification.description: Verification must define a concrete command or manual assertion and explicit outcomes.

golden-plan-shapes.description: Modular, tenant-shared and provider-integration plans of thirty-six skills each validate clean, so shape-specific rules are calibrated on more than one shape.

good-distinct-shared-safety.description: Distinct procedures share one exact approved safety block.

invalid-evidence.description: Evidence attempts target traversal or names a missing file.

irrelevant-evidence-reuse.description: An integration reuses valid evidence that does not identify it.

large-plan-calibration.description: A thirty-six skill plan, honest by construction, validates with zero blocking diagnostics.

legacy-publication-ineligible.description: Schema 1.0 and 1.1 remain auditable but cannot validate authored publication output.

lexically-unique-empty.description: Long varied prose has no traceable project procedure or contract decisions.

missing-evidence.description: A skill references an evidence ID absent from the plan.

nonconforming-agent-file.description: An extra Markdown wrapper outside the planned <skill>-agent naming contract is rejected.

noun-substituted-template.description: One prose template serves two skills, differing only in the project nouns each plan contract forces it to carry; every line is lexically distinct.

operational-content-calibration.description: Honest instruction stays clean: project-specific verbs outside the whitelist, delegation and decision steps, and steps carrying no anchor of their own.

paraphrased-empty.description: Headings are present but the operational contract is filler.

path-contract-classification.description: Every path is normalized and classified as resolving, generated, or safely creatable.

procedure-role-collapse-calibration.description: Two obligations honestly sharing one step in a small skill stay clean; only the unambiguous collapse blocks.

procedure-role-collapsed.description: Three or more catalog obligations are all discharged by one general inspection step.

procedure-role-wiring.description: A role is declared with requirements but names neither the evidence that grounds it nor the step that discharges it.

provider-safety.description: Provider access requires a safe default and explicit authorization.

read-only-mutation.description: Read-only contracts cannot use write-oriented procedure language.

registry-coverage-bypass.description: A canonical candidate is neither selected nor rejected, or its catalog anchor is invalid.

repunctuated-template.description: The same template again, the second skill differing from the first only in punctuation and interchangeable connectives.

review-verification-not-executed.description: The adversarial review judged a prescribed command from the page instead of running it.

routing-case-coverage.description: Routing fixtures cover self-selection and every adjacent owner.

routing-tautology.description: A routing fixture names the skill it expects to win, so no routing decision is tested.

routing-tautology-calibration.description: A runtime-fixed skill may be named by its own subject; a memory request cannot avoid the word memory.

scan-secret-covered.description: A scanner claims to have covered a secret-bearing file, which the contract forbids reading.

scan-surface-unaccounted.description: A module of the target received no disposition from any scanner.

schema-1.4-valid.description: A complete typed contract at the current schema passes both plan-only and authored validation.

scope-collision.description: Sibling skills claim the same owned scope.

skill-body-command-calibration.description: Class names, config paths, constants, and read-only tooling in backticks are not commands.

skill-body-command-risk.description: Skill prose hands the agent a destructive, mutating, or provider-calling command.

template-reuse-calibration.description: Honest inventories stay clean: two genuinely different skills, an approved versioned fixed block repeated word for word, and the same framework idiom shown in a fenced code block.

unjustified-inventory-growth.description: A catalog candidate is added without a satisfied evidence-backed selection condition.

unsupported-evidence-claim.description: A selection condition repeats a claim that the cited source/range does not support.

vacuous-operational-content.description: A skill names real project files, classes, and constants in every section, traces to every plan contract, and still commands nothing: procedure steps hedge instead of acting and verification accepts an impression.

verbatim-boundary.description: A declared primary/defer precedence cannot resolve an owned scope, ownership description, or positive trigger that both skills claim word for word.

verification-baseline-calibration.description: The same failing baseline with a differential expectation stays clean.

verification-baseline-contradicted.description: An expectation promises the command succeeds outright while its recorded baseline fails on the unmodified target.

verification-baseline-missing.description: An executable check this gate cannot resolve declares an expectation for a command nobody observed.
